posts.author: Pixelbird14
posts.body:
Sup, fellow engine slaves? (JK)
Resource Type:
(Battler, faceset, charset)
Maker Type:
MZ
I'm currently working on the sequel (AttVoV: Destiny) to my original game (AttVoV), and the game has several plotlines. One of these plotlines is called "AttVoV: Fragments of INFINITY":
Spoiler:
Basic Plot of Subplot
@Erif
's
Kamil and Gianna
lost a battle to
The Sovereign
in my original game, and after the loss, they went around from universe to universe, gathering characters to help join them in their quest to defeat The Sovereign. Some of them accepted the offer, while others ran away to do their own stuff.
What do i need from you?:
A custom actor and the names for 1-2 special moves and one signature (ultimate attack) move if your character has a battle.
Submission requirements:
The three graphics mentioned above (Battler, Charset, Faceset)
The name of said character
Class of your character (I can work with pretty much anything)
Names for Two-Three moves (1-2 Special moves, and "ultimate attack".)
(Optional) Some backstory (So I can understand them better dialogue-wise)
(Optional) Their overworld/Battle themes. Adds to the "vibe".
Cameo Type
Kamil Assistant:
Works directly under Kamil/Gianna in lategame, are pretty difficult bossfights. (3 slots available)
Kamil Subordinate:
Works for Kamil/Gianna, but appears earlier in the game. Doesn't have too much special dialogue with Kamil. Can be a boss or a miniboss. (10 Slots available)
Enemy:
Doesn't work for Kamil/Gianna, but still against the protags. Has some dialogue and a miniboss, but that's all. (Unlimited slots)
Questgiver
: Usually a good guy helping the protags. Their quest can range from a spar to getting an item, etc. They help distract some antagonists later in the game if you help them (Unlimited slots)
An item to recieve from the character (Can be a weapon, some armor, or anything really.)
If you need more info on the plot, or you need me to draw something, I'll be happy to talk with you in DMs.
You can write a scenario related to your game, to set it as point of why your character needs help to return to their world.
I can also write it myself and double-check with you.
I will ask questions because I can be kinda clueless. Bear with me if you can ;P
If you need to pull your character out last-minute, that's alright.
In return, I will give:
Rights to include my characters in your game (with credit)
Art (If needed)
You'll be featured in the credits, credits doc, and trailer credits.
Whenever your character is shown in something I post, I'll credit you!
You'll get the game for free (Wow, you saved 5 bucks.)
If your character uses custom resources, write the names of the creators of these resources, so they may receive credit as well.
Actors of any artstyle and race work. Swearing for dialogue is allowed, but keep it minimal.
When you can, let me know how you would like to be credited.
Thanks in advance!
Samples:
Battler
Character (Walking)
Faceset
Spoiler:
Characters Involved
@Erif
's Kamil and Gianna

Spoiler
NAME:
SOPHRONIA GOODFISHER
BACKSTORY:
Grew up in a fishing village in a country where Inquisitors policed and oppresed mages. After her wife, a priestess and healer, is murdered by Inquisitors, Sophronia joins and eventually leads a rebellion against them. She does not suffer fools, hates bullies, and is pragmatic and stern. She is confident, bordering on arrogant.
CLASS:
Battle Mage
MOVES:
Mind Spike (Psychic attack that causes confusion), Lightning Bolt (Self Explanatory)
ULTIMATE:
Psychic Scream (A wave of psychic energy that deals heavy damage to all, and can potentially end lives instantly.)
GEAR:
Cloak of Atreides (A magical cloak that shields from detection), Scythe of Woe (A magical scythe that causes necrotic damage and life drain), Amulet of the Devout (A magical amulet that belonged to her wife. Grants resistance to fire and radiant. Buffs healing.)
ROLE
Spoiler
Any that will fit the character based on her description above.
